title: Void (Within Window)
when: Ticket state = Just booked (within void window)
fl_steps: Check claimability in Edvin
Process Void in GDS (TRDC/ALL for Amadeus, etc.)
Cancel associated EMD ancillaries
Run Rebooking Wizard / Refund
forbidden: Do not process void if claimability is False
Do not forget to cancel EMDs
source: Lesson: Introduction to Cancellations

title: Add Ancillary (< 48h before departure)
fl_steps: Inform customer it is too close to departure (48h deadline for LCC/portal)
Escalate if strictly needed per doc
alternatives: Suggest purchasing directly at the airport
forbidden: Do not attempt to add ancillaries via GDS/Edvin <48h
handoff: Customer Care Escalations (if urgent YY needed)
source: LCC Ancillaries Guidelines

title: LCC Void (Same Calendar Day)
fl_steps: Inform customer handling fees apply
Select 'Void' in Modify Order
Copy pop-up message into errand
Send CXL conf LCC void
forbidden: Never promise a full refund for LCC
source: Lesson: LCC Handling

title: Amadeus Rebooking (Unused Ticket)
fl_steps: Ensure Segment is HK and Ticket is O (Open)
Use FXQ/FXO to calculate
Deduct penalty manually if customer has Flexible Ticket
Send payment link
XE old segment, ER to save
Handoff to Fulfillment via Rebooking Wizard
alternatives: Void & Rebook if within void window (cheaper)
forbidden: Do not downgrade booking class
Do not forget to check Flexible Ticket in Edvin
source: Lesson: Amadeus Rebooking - ATC

title: Name Correction (NACO <=3 chars / marriage)
fl_steps: Check 24h void rule first
Check Edvin 'NAME' tab for airline policy
Collect airline + handling fee (waived if Support Package)
Update Name & Reissue Ticket
alternatives: Void and rebook if within window
forbidden: Do not guarantee name change without checking Edvin
Brazilian customers: always initiate with airline first
source: Lesson: NACO/NACH

title: Involuntary Disruption (Force Majeure / Schedule Change)
when: Disruption flag = Force Majeure / Schedule Change
fl_steps: Verify airline FM/SC policy in Edvin
Process involuntary refund/rebooking
Ensure NO ETG service fee is applied
forbidden: Do not apply ETG voluntary service fee
source: Lesson: Force Majeure or Schedule Change?

title: GDS Rebooking Eligibility Gate
fl_steps: Check Flexible Ticket or Support Package first — different flow applies
Check ticket coupon status: only 'O/A' Open proceeds here; C/E/S statuses go to dedicated status guideline
Check for an active Schedule Change (UN/TK) — handle SC first if present
Check Force Majeure applicability — if FM applies, no rebooking fee is charged
Check Void/24h window eligibility before running any manual/ATC pricing
Confirm at least 4h before original departure or 6h before the new flight, else rebooking cannot be processed
Check whether Post Booking Automation (PBA) can complete this rebooking end-to-end before doing anything manual
Always verify ticket validity in Edvin docs before pricing
forbidden: Do not skip straight to GDS pricing without this gate
Do not quote fewer than 3 rebooking options unless the 10-minute mark has passed
source: 1. Rebooking General Guidelines (ETG Shelf)

title: GDS Rebooking: Split Partial Pax First
fl_steps: Split the PNR first — Amadeus: SP (e.g. SP1,2) then ER to save, RTAXR to retrieve the split PNR; Sabre: equivalent split entry
Work the rebooking only on the split-off PNR containing the pax who are changing
Leave the original PNR untouched for the pax keeping the current date
Continue with the Unused or Partially-used rebooking path depending on the split PNR's ticket status
forbidden: Do not rebook mixed-date pax inside a single PNR without splitting first
Do not rely on automation for partial-pax rebooking — it does not auto-split
source: Section 1: Split a Reservation; 03. Multi-PNR routine

title: Amadeus Rebook: Partially Used Ticket (Manual Calculation)
when: Ticket State = Partially used (one segment flown)
fl_steps: Try ATC first — if it errors on the used segment, switch to manual calculation
Enter manual pricing with an FQP entry (departure city / class / date), keeping the flown segment as used
Compare the new fare + tax to the original: quote Ticket difference + tax difference
Mandatory email verification gate if call is voluntary change on issued ticket
Add the ETG Volume Rebooking service fee on top of the airline ticket difference
Collect via MOTO or send Payment Link (valid 30 min)
Once paid, use Rebooking Wizard (NOT Modify Order) to send to Ticketing
alternatives: Void & Rebook instead if still inside the void window
forbidden: Do not use Modify Order for a rebooking with no refund involved
Do not price the flown segment as if the ticket were fully unused
source: Manual Rebooking Amadeus; 2. Partially used ticket; 00. Rebooking fees & commands — cheat

title: Sabre Rebook: Partially Used Ticket (Manual Calculation)
when: Ticket State = Partially used (one segment flown)
fl_steps: Confirm automated reissue is not available for a partially-used ticket in Sabre
Run a manual reprice for the unused segment(s) only, per the Manual Rebooking Sabre entry format
Compare the quoted new fare/tax to the original ticket: quote Ticket difference + tax difference
Add the ETG Volume Rebooking service fee
Once paid, use Rebooking Wizard (NOT Modify Order) to send to Ticketing
forbidden: Do not use Modify Order when no refund is involved
Do not reprice the already-flown segment
source: Manual Rebooking Sabre; Cheatsheet: Rebooking (Amadeus & Sabre)

title: GDS Rebook: Void and Rebook (Within 24h/Void Window)
when: Time since issuance = within Void/24h window
fl_steps: Confirm the Void/24h rule still applies (check Edvin + fare rules)
Void the existing ticket (e.g. Amadeus TRDC/ALL, or Sabre WV)
Create the new itinerary and issue a new ticket sell
No airline penalty applies — customer only pays fare difference (if any) plus applicable service fee
alternatives: If the Void window has passed, use the standard Unused or Partially-used rebooking path instead
forbidden: Do not void after the void window has closed
Do not skip the 24h-rule eligibility check before offering Void
source: 2. Rebooking within the Void period; 17. Step by Step - Void a Ticket - Amadeus, Sabre

title: Coupon Status Branch (Status != O/Open)
fl_steps: Run RTTN or *T to display ticket image and read coupon status per segment

Match status: A (Airport Control - verify Edvin), C (Checked in - ask YY to open), E (Exchanged - check new ticket), F/L (Flown/Lifted - NO reissue), S (Suspended - queue to Support to ask YY open), U (Unknown - ask YY open), V (Voided - new sell)
If status blocks reissue, request airline (YY) open ticket before quoting customer
Never promise a rebooking price until coupon status allows reissue
forbidden: Do not quote or promise a rebooking before confirming coupon status allows reissue
Do not treat status F or L as reissuable
source: 02. How to Interpret Flight Status Codes; Section 3: Different Ticket Status

title: GDS Cancellation Eligibility Gate
when: Before applying any fee or automation
fl_steps: Check order/segment status is confirmed in GDS/Portal; if not issued, refresh and re-check — if not issued, full refund applies
Check ticket coupon status is fully Open — for any other status, use Coupon Status Branch
Check SC/FM applicability before applying any voluntary fee
Go to Refund tab → Check Claimability in Edvin for reason 'Void'
If automation applies, skip manual rule check; if only some pax cancelling, automation does not apply — go manual
If Void no longer applies, check 24h airline rule next, then fare rules
forbidden: Do not skip Void/24h check before reading fare rules
Do not assume automation covers partial-passenger cancellation
source: 1. Cancellation within the Void period; 00. Cancellation & Void — cheat

title: GDS Cancellation: Void Automation
fl_steps: Check Claimability shows reason 'Void' with Total refund amount
Inform customer of Total refund amount
If order is CC2C, charge our service fee in advance before proceeding
Run Modify Order → Void
Check automation result: Success → send CXL confirmation email, handoff to Refunds; Fail → auto-routes to SL Refunds queue
forbidden: Do not manually void again after failed automation — it auto-queues to SL Refunds
Do not promise refund amount before Check Claimability confirms it
handoff: Refunds (SL Refunds queue on automation fail)
source: 1. Cancellation within the Void period; Study Guide — CC Amadeus Cancellations

title: GDS Cancellation: Void Partial Pax Manual
fl_steps: Automation does not split — split PNR manually first: Amadeus SP1(,2) → EF → ER, find split PNR with RTAXR
Add ghost line, cancel relevant segment(s) on split-off PNR
Void corresponding ticket(s) for cancelling pax
Link new split PNR to order in Edvin
Run Modify Order → Void on split PNR, then send CXL confirmation email
forbidden: Do not cancel/void shared PNR directly without splitting first
If passenger being cancelled is linked to an infant staying in booking, escalate to Support instead
source: 00. Cancellation & Void — cheat; 1. Cancellation within the Void period

title: GDS Cancellation: 24h Airline Rule
fl_steps: Check Claimability again; if automation supports 24h reason, run Modify Order directly
If manual: check Edvin Documents for 24h rule — if not stated, treat as not applicable
Delete segment with X, save with ER
Run Modify Order with reason '24h airline rule'
Send Void/24h email template, handoff to Refunds
alternatives: Brazil market: full refund with no fee if within Void/24h AND departure >=7 days after purchase — use reason '24H BR Cancellation'
forbidden: Do not use Vietnam time or customer local time for 24h deadline — always use Edvin office time
Do not apply Brazil exception outside its exact conditions
source: Study Guide — CC Amadeus Cancellations; 00. Cancellation & Void — cheat

title: GDS Cancellation: Voluntary Fare Rules
when: Void and 24h rule do not apply
fl_steps: Read fare rules: Smart Flow FQP first, fallback FXX, fallback FQD, then read FQN*PE for penalty
Determine category: Non-refundable / Refundable against fee / Waived / Tax refund only
If refundable against fee: convert penalty to customer currency, add ETG service fee, present per pax — use Modify Order reason 'Ticket rules - airline fee'
If tax-only refund: use Modify Order reason 'Ticket rules - taxes' — split first if only some pax
Check No-show deadline — if already no-show, apply higher of cancellation vs no-show penalty
forbidden: Do not treat YQ/YR carrier surcharges as automatically refundable — verify in Edvin Documents
Do not waive a penalty without documented proof/authorization
source: Study Guide — CC Amadeus Cancellations; 00. Cancellation & Void — cheat

title: GDS Ancillaries: Paid Seat/Baggage/Meal (EMD)
fl_steps: Open ancillary catalog: Amadeus FXK (or seat map SM+segment); Sabre 4G[segment]* or Air Extras
Add SSR: Amadeus 'SR [code]/free text /P[pax]/S[segment]'; Sabre '3[code]/[free text]-[pax]'
Confirm SSR status is HK (Amadeus) or HD1/PAYMENT REQUIRED (Sabre) before charging — check AES/*AE
Charge customer via Add-on purchases in Edvin (Baggage GDS / Seating GDS / Meal GDS)
Register errand with template 'TKT info EMD Ancillary' and place on Ticketing queue (BOM TKT / UPA TKT – Ancillary post sales) for EMD issuance
forbidden: Do not charge customer before SSR status is confirmed
Do not skip Ticketing queue step — EMD must be issued by Ticketing
Round-trip: add baggage for each leg separately, do not assume one entry covers both
handoff: Ticketing (BOM TKT / UPA TKT – Ancillary post sales)
source: 3. Ancillaries step by step guidelines; Chapter 4: Sabre — Add Request

title: GDS Ancillaries: Free of Charge (FOC Seating / Special Assistance)
when: Item is free of charge (FOC seating, wheelchair WCHR/WCHS/WCHC)
fl_steps: Add SSR as usual (seat map or wheelchair SSR code) — no EMD required
Confirm request shows Confirmed/HK status; if not, save with ER and refresh with IR
Do not queue to Ticketing and do not create EMD errand — these are FOC
forbidden: Do not charge fee for wheelchair assistance or genuine FOC seat
Do not use paid-ancillary Ticketing queue template for FOC items
source: 5. Seating FOC with airline; Chapter: Complete Course Summary — IAG Basics

title: GDS Ancillaries: Unconfirmed SSR or Customer Declines
when: SSR does not confirm, or customer declines to pay
fl_steps: If SSR stays unconfirmed (e.g. NO FARE FOR CLASS USED), refer customer to airline directly
If customer decides not to pay, remove SSR: XE[line] then ER, and register normal errand
forbidden: Do not leave unconfirmed or unpaid SSR sitting in PNR — remove it
source: 2. How to add ancillaries

title: GDS Ancillaries: Deadline Check (<48h)
fl_steps: LCC ancillaries: deadline is 48h before departure — check LCC tab in Edvin Docs
Portals/NDC bookings: must be >48h before departure; if closer, refer to airline (YY) or escalate per doc
GDS (Amadeus/Sabre) bookings generally not bound by 48h rule, but verify ticket/SSR status is workable
forbidden: Do not assume GDS deadline-free handling applies to LCC or NDC/portal bookings
source: 1. Available products/services; 3. Ancillaries step by step guidelines

title: Refund: Pre-check & Information Gathering
fl_steps: Gather ticket numbers, penalty fees, refund reason, travel date, and whether PNR was cancelled before or after departure (no-show)
Amadeus: check ticket with TWD/TKT[ticket number]; find ticket via RTF/RTTN/RHFA; check history via RHA (XS marks cancelled segment)
Sabre: check ticket via *T then WETR*[line]; check history via HIA* and convert Tulsa time to local airport time
Confirm voluntary vs involuntary
Check Edvin Documents → Cancellations and Refund for airline rules
forbidden: Do not promise refund amount before confirming ticket status and reading fare rule/Edvin docs
Do not skip checking whether all pax share same fare basis
source: 1. How to collect information before claiming refund (Amadeus & Sabre)

title: Refund: Coupon Status Eligibility Gate
when: Need to confirm a refund is possible
fl_steps: Amadeus: refund possible only if coupon status (ST) is O (Open), F (Flown), or A (Airport control)
Sabre: refund possible only if coupon status (STAT) is OPEN or ACTRL (Airport control)
If status is anything else, refund not directly possible — use coupon-status branch rule
forbidden: Do not submit refund claim on coupon that is not O/F/A (Amadeus) or OPEN/ACTRL (Sabre)
source: 1. How to collect information before claiming refund (Amadeus & Sabre)

title: Refund: Edvin Calculator (ATC) & Modify Order
when: Order is original, active, not already changed/cancelled, not a same-day departure
fl_steps: Open Refund tab in Edvin and use Edvin Calculator (ATC)
Inform customer of total refundable amount shown, including tax refund
Run Modify Order with correct cancellation reason — removes segments, adds ghost line, voids/claims ticket
Use Apply Macro in Zendesk to hand off to Refunds and close ticket as Resolved
forbidden: Do not manually recalculate refund when Edvin Calculator already gives result — just run Modify Order with correct reason
handoff: Refunds (SL Refunds) via Zendesk Apply Macro
source: Section 1: Edvin Refund Calculator (ATC) introduction

title: Sabre: Automated Voluntary Refund
fl_steps: Confirm voluntary only, airline connected (~35 airlines), ticket issued in Sabre
If cancelling before departure, refund must also be processed before departure
Enter WFRA[ticket number] or WFRATR[line] to open refund mask
Review total refund amount, coupon status per segment, fare/tax refunded, cancellation fee
Confirm by adding /REF to entry: WFRA[ticket number]/REF or WFRATR[line]/REF
forbidden: Do not use Automated Refund for involuntary reasons (FM, SC, 24h, duplicate)
Do not attempt post-departure Automated Refund when booking cancelled before departure
source: 1. Automated Refund (Sabre)

title: GDS Refund: Manual Voluntary Calculation
when: Reason = Voluntary (customer cancels against fare rules)
Automated Refund / Edvin Calculator not applicable
fl_steps: Open fare rule: Amadeus FQD... then FQN*PE; Sabre FQ... then RD*PE
Read full penalty rule; check all fare bases if multiple
Check Edvin Documents for airline exceptions (partial tax refund allowance, penalty per pricing unit)
Open refund mask and process
Always confirm non-refundable taxes before submitting claim
forbidden: Do not submit refund claim without reading complete penalty rule first
Do not assume discount for children/infants without verifying ticketed price
handoff: Refunds (SL Refunds) if manual GDS refund cannot be completed by FL
source: 2. How to process voluntary refunds; 1. How to collect information before claiming refund

title: GDS Refund: Involuntary (Schedule Change / Force Majeure)
when: Reason = Involuntary (Schedule Change or Force Majeure)
fl_steps: Never use Automated Refund or standard voluntary penalty for involuntary cases
Check Edvin refund case notes and Documents for specific SC/FM handling
Always refund EMDs for ancillary products in same PNR when reason is SC/FM
Sabre does not allow partial EMD refunds — use BSP (if allowed) or Amadeus if doc allows
If Schedule Change delay is >=2 hours, submit Refund Application (RA) in BSP rather than GDS refund
forbidden: Do not apply voluntary penalty calculation to involuntary SC/FM case
Do not forget to refund related ancillary EMDs on involuntary SC/FM cases
source: 3/4. How to process Involuntary refunds; EMD Refund in Case of FM/SC

title: Reroute: IATA Area & Route Feasibility Check
fl_steps: Check whether new routing stays in same IATA area and keeps consistent origin/arrival pair
Most airlines do not allow rerouting between different IATA areas or domestic to international
If change crosses IATA areas, check specific airline fare rules for exceptions in Edvin Docs
forbidden: Do not promise reroute across IATA areas without confirming explicit fare-rule exception
source: 5. Rerouting according to fare rules

title: Reroute: Status Gate & Timing
fl_steps: Check order/segments are confirmed in GDS/Portal
If coupon status is O or A, proceed to ATC check; if C/E/S, use coupon-status branch rule
Reissue must be completed before original flight departs, or passenger becomes no-show
forbidden: Do not attempt reroute reissue after original flight has departed without checking no-show
source: 5. Rerouting according to fare rules

title: Reroute: Pricing (ATC vs Manual)
fl_steps: Try ATC first (Amadeus FXO/R,UP/...; Sabre WFRF) — if fare guaranteed, note total reroute charge
If ATC not guaranteed, calculate fare-by-fare and tax-by-tax manually, adding penalty on top: Total = Penalty + Fare diff + Tax diff
forbidden: Do not skip adding airline penalty when calculating manually
source: 5. Rerouting according to fare rules

title: Reroute: Fare Rules Verification
fl_steps: Check Rebooking tab in Edvin Docs
Read fare rules: destination changes check both PE (Penalties) and RU (Rules) sections; stopover check PE and SO
If partially used, check fare rules for both used and unused parts
Check No-show policy/timeframe
forbidden: Do not rely only on PE section for destination change — RU must also be checked
source: 5. Rerouting according to fare rules; 3. Upgrade, destination changes and stopover

title: Reroute: Upgrade Cabin / Stopover Variants
when: Request = Upgrade cabin, destination change, or add stopover (sub-cases of Reroute)
fl_steps: Upgrade: try ATC (Amadeus FXO/R,UP/KC,+); if fails, check CO section of fare rules to confirm upgrade allowed even if changes restricted, then price FXX/FQP
Destination change: try ATC first; if fails, check PE and RU sections
Stopover: try ATC first; if fails, check PE and SO sections (extra fee/conditions)
forbidden: Do not assume upgrade is blocked just because general changes restricted — CO section must be read
source: 3. Upgrade, destination changes and stopover

title: Reroute: Inform & Charge Customer
when: Fare rules confirm rerouting is permitted
fl_steps: Inform customer of airline rerouting fee + fare diff + our rebooking service fee
If baggage was issued via EMD, warn customer transfer to rerouted ticket is not guaranteed
Phone voluntary change on issued ticket: mandatory email verification gate in Edvin before charging
Create Add-on purchase in Edvin: Airline Cost and other = fare diff; add Our Service Fee - Vol. Rebooking
Describe new flight details and affected pax/PNR in Text to customer box
forbidden: Do not charge before completing mandatory phone email verification
Do not guarantee baggage will transfer automatically when purchased via EMD
source: 5. Rerouting according to fare rules

title: Reroute: Finalize Reissue (Confirmed & Paid)
fl_steps: If only some pax rerouting, split PNR first and link new PNR in Edvin
GDS/Farelogix: add and save new segments, then remove old ones; submit via Rebooking Wizard (Voluntary rebooking) to Ticketing Team
Portal: add and save new segments, remove old ones, finalize on Portal, update Edvin, send updated ticket with Sync Trip
forbidden: Do not remove old segments before new ones are saved successfully
source: 5. Rerouting according to fare rules

title: Reroute: Not Confirmed / Not Paid
when: Customer does not confirm or does not pay during interaction
fl_steps: GDS/Farelogix: make no changes to booking; fill Rebooking Wizard and select 'No queue action'
Portal: make no changes to booking; register errand with new flight details and quote given
forbidden: Do not make any GDS/Portal changes if customer has not confirmed and paid
source: 5. Rerouting according to fare rules

title: Reroute: Overcollection Handling (> 10 EUR vs < 10 EUR)
when: An overcollection is identified after charging
fl_steps: GDS: if overcollection is > 10 EUR, note amount in 'Information to Ticketing' box — do NOT send to SL Refund, Ticketing handles it
LCC/Portal: if overcollection is > 10 EUR, use Modify Order reason 'Ancillary voluntary', select product, amend amount in customer currency
If under 10 EUR, take no action unless customer requests it — then get TL approval first
forbidden: Do not send a GDS overcollection to SL Refund — only Ticketing handles it
Do not refund an under-10-EUR overcollection without TL approval
source: 5. Rerouting according to fare rules (Overcollection Handling)

title: Cancel Some Passengers in Multi-Pax PNR (Cross-Cutting)
when: Only some passengers in a multi-passenger PNR want to cancel (not all)
fl_steps: Automation (Void, 24h, 24H BR) NEVER applies to partial-pax cancellations — proceed manually
Split PNR first: Amadeus SP[pax] (e.g. SP1,2) → EF → ER, find split PNR with RTAXR; Sabre SP[pax] or D+[pax], sign 6+initials, retrieve with *D
Link new split PNR to order in Edvin (Edvin > Link PNR) before doing anything else
Work cancellation on split-off PNR only, following normal path for applicable reason
Name specific pax being cancelled in customer messages (include infant names too)
In Modify Order, set order status to 'Changed' (NOT 'Cancelled') since whole trip is not cancelled
forbidden: Do not rely on Void/24h automation for partial-pax request — it will not split
Do not cancel/void original PNR directly without splitting first
Do not mark order status as fully 'Cancelled' when only some passengers cancelled
source: Section 1: Split a Reservation; 7. How to Split; Section 2: Modify Order and Send Mail

title: Cancellation: Multi-PNR Order (GDS + LCC or multiple GDS)
when: The order itself has multiple PNRs (e.g. GDS + LCC, or several GDS PNRs)
fl_steps: Confirm with customer exactly which PNR(s) are affected — do not assume cancelling one cancels whole order
Check cancellation policy separately for each affected PNR
If same reason applies to all affected PNRs, run Modify Order once selecting all those PNRs
If different reasons apply, run Modify Order separately per PNR
If order mixes LCC + GDS and customer only cancels GDS, handle GDS manually — automation void does not apply to mixed case
Transfer tickets to correct teams separately rather than bundling
forbidden: Do not assume all PNRs in multi-PNR order share same cancellation reason or eligibility
Do not cancel a PNR customer didn't confirm just because it's in the same order
source: 7. Cancellation of multi-PNR orders

title: Schedule Change: Detection & Classification
when: Customer says the airline changed a flight time/date/route
Any voice interaction where you must confirm whether this is a Schedule Change
fl_steps: Check FM/Travel Alert tab in Edvin first — if FM applies, follow FM guidelines instead of SC
Detect SC in GDS: look for UN (airline hasn't confirmed flight) or TK (time change offered) segment status; view itinerary history with RHI (Amadeus) / *HI (Sabre)
Always check Edvin errand history first to see if SC team already handled/offered alternatives

Classify: Trivial (<=30 min change, no misconnection, same origin/dest); Minor (31 min–5h, no misconnection, same origin/dest); Major (>5h, direct<->stop change, added stop, origin/dest change, connection in different country); Critical (no alternative offered, or misconnection); No SC (glitch/reverted)
forbidden: Do not classify route/origin/dest change as Trivial/Minor even if time change is small
Do not skip FM/Travel Alert check before applying SC classification
source: Chapter 13: Schedule Change Handling for First Line Agents

title: Schedule Change: Trivial / Minor (FL Action)
when: SC classified as Trivial or Minor
fl_steps: Minor SC generally handled by SC Automation/Script (TOUCHLESS / POST BOOKING AUTOMATION / TAAM) — check history to confirm
If script hasn't run yet or Trivial: empathize, acknowledge small time change, and if customer accepts, manually accept in GDS: Amadeus ERK, Sabre EWR, Galileo @all (TK -> HK), then send Sync Trip
Only offer what is within FL authority — do not negotiate alternative flight with airline yourself; refer to airline or log for SC team
Do not charge any fee for initial involuntary rebooking/refund on Trivial/Minor SC
forbidden: Do not attempt to negotiate new alternative with airline yourself for Trivial/Minor SC
Do not charge customer for initial involuntary SC change
handoff: None for true Trivial/Minor; escalate only if automation did not run and manual accept fails
source: Chapter 13 (Types of Schedule Change; SC Automation/Script; SC Fee Policy)

title: Schedule Change: Major / Critical (Blind Transfer)
when: SC classified as Major or Critical
fl_steps: Do not attempt to resolve Major/Critical SC yourself — routed to manual handling
Run Transfer Checklist: confirm skill/order type, target language, destination queue within operating hours
Use only assigned Genesys queue for order type — never mix Booking.com with non-Booking.com; do not language transfer emails
Transfer via Transfer → search queue → Blind
Show empathy and explain specialized team will review options — do not promise specific outcome
forbidden: Do not try to manually resolve Major/Critical SC yourself
Do not promise refund/rebooking outcome before transferring
Do not mix Booking.com and non-Booking.com queues
handoff: SC Customer Facing (CF) team via Genesys blind transfer
source: Chapter 13 (Transfer Checklist; How the SC Team Is Organized)

title: Schedule Change: Fee Policy & Exceptions
when: SC case involves a second/additional alternative request
fl_steps: No fee applies to initial involuntary SC rebooking/refund for any customer tier
'Our Service Fee – Invol. Rebooking SC' (15 EUR) can only be charged to Basic-tier customers, and only when airline offered valid alternative and customer requests additional one
Never charge this fee for Booking.com orders, Businessclass.com orders, or Platinum Package customers requesting second alternative
forbidden: Do not charge any SC fee to Booking.com, Businessclass.com, or Platinum Package customers
Do not charge for first/initial alternative on any tier
source: Chapter 13 (Schedule Change Fee Policy)

title: Mandatory Email Verification Gate (Phone Voluntary Change)
when: Customer confirms a voluntary change to an existing ISSUED ticket — cancellation, rebooking, or name correction/change (including changes covered by Flexible Ticket, CFAR, or Cancellation Guarantee)
Before charging the customer or processing the request
fl_steps: Verify customer's email address before charging or processing — use 'Verify email' button in Edvin
Applies even to free-of-charge requests or requests paid via MOTO
No extra verification needed when payment link is sent or additional doc requested
Always send email correspondence only to email address already registered in Edvin
forbidden: Do not apply this gate to chat or email interactions — phone only
Do not apply this gate to adding ancillaries/passengers to existing order, or general queries
Do not send email to different address than one registered in Edvin — customer must update registered details first
source: Email verification before proceeding with request (ETG Shelf)

title: Rebooking: No-Show Master Flow
when: Passenger did not fly previous segment (no-show)
fl_steps: Determine whether ticket was already processed as Unused/NSR (refund) in Edvin Refund tab / GDS status R — if NSR, create brand new PNR (compare total price against 50% of Edvin Air if partially used)
If FM applies to no-show, check FM page first before quoting fare diff
If NOT processed as NSR and coupon status is Open: confirm no-show in history, try ATC/WFRF (always check Turkish TK fare rules manually)
If ATC/WFRF fails, read fare rules for no-show conditions; only calculate manually if explicitly permitted
If coupon status is S (Suspended): quote minimum cost (change fee + no-show fee + service fee), place booking in Support queue for airline reopen
If PNR expired in GDS: retrieve ticket by number, create new PNR with same airline, attach old ticket number, try ATC first
Mandatory email verification gate applies before charging
forbidden: Do not treat NSR-refunded ticket as reissuable on old PNR — create new PNR
Do not skip Turkish Airlines fare-rule check even when ATC/WFRF succeeds
Do not attempt to reopen S (Suspended) status yourself — requires Support queue
Do not offer rebooking when fare rules do not permit changes
handoff: Fulfillment/Ticketing (Rebooking Wizard); Support queue for S status
source: 1. Rebooking when ticket is cancelled as unused; 3. Status S (Suspended); 2. PNR expired in GDS

title: Sabre: Coupon Status Check (STAT & BAG)
when: Need to confirm ticket coupon status before rebooking/refund/reroute
fl_steps: Retrieve *PNR then *T (or *P7) to list ticket and line numbers
Open ticket with WETR*[line] or WETR*T[ticket number] to read STAT per coupon
STAT values: OPEN, ACTRL allow reissue/refund; USED/F already flown; S (Suspended) needs airline reopen; E (Exchanged) check new ticket
Note BAG allowance next to fare — carry same bag count into new segment
Use *H7 / *HT (ticket history) if STAT unclear or recently changed
forbidden: Do not proceed with pricing before reading STAT via WETR*
Do not confuse Sabre STAT codes with Amadeus ST codes
source: 2. Sabre Entries; 1. How to collect information before claiming refund (Sabre)

title: Sabre: No-Show Rebook Commands
fl_steps: Confirm PCC: *S shows current PCC; switch with AAA[PCC] to match issuing office for WFRF
Confirm no-show via *H7, *HT before touching pricing
Add new segment(s) keeping status SS until saved
Try automated reissue: WFRFTR[line]¥A[YY]¥N[pax].1¥S[new segments] (add ¥NCB for lowest class)
Always check Turkish Airlines (TK) fare rules manually even if WFRFTR succeeds
If fails, fall back to manual: WFRTR[line]¥A[YY]¥N[pax].1¥S[segments] (partially used format), read EQV/BASE for fare, MD for old tax, add penalty from AFTER DEPARTURE section
Save with X in Retain box → TRANSACTION RETAINED → delete old segments (X1-2) → sign 6+initials → ER
Route to Ticketing via Rebooking Wizard
alternatives: Amadeus FQP smart flow: WETR*x for IATA code → PV/[iata code] in Amadeus → run FQP script without retrieving PNR
forbidden: Do not run WFRF/WFRFTR from PCC other than ticket issuing office
Do not skip Turkish Airlines fare-rule check
Do not treat WFRTR as able to price more than 1 pax per run
source: Manual Rebooking Sabre; Rebooking with WFRF - Unused ticket; 2. Sabre Entries

title: Sabre: Retrieve Purged/Expired PNR
when: PNR/ghost line has expired in GDS
fl_steps: Retrieve purged PNR with *XXXX-[6-char locator]-P (fixed prefix *XXXX, hyphen, locator, hyphen, suffix P)
Locate old ticket number from Edvin/history
Create brand-new PNR with same airline per fare rules, attach old ticket number (specify pax association for multi-pax)
Try WFRFTR/ATC first; if unavailable, calculate manually (fare diff + tax diff + change fee + no-show fee + service fee)
Route to Ticketing via Rebooking Wizard once payment collected
forbidden: Do not attempt to rebook directly on expired/purged PNR without retrieving or recreating first
source: 2. Sabre Entries (Retrieve Purged PNR); 2. If the PNR is expired in the GDS

title: Multi-PNR: LCC + GDS Combo (Rebooking & Reroute)
when: Order has multiple PNRs, at least one LCC and at least one GDS
fl_steps: Confirm with customer exactly which PNR(s) are changing: LCC only, GDS only, or both — never assume changing one affects other
If only GDS PNR changing, follow normal Amadeus/Sabre path on GDS PNR only; leave LCC PNR untouched
If only LCC PNR changing, follow LCC path per LCC guidelines; leave GDS PNR untouched
If both changing, run each PNR through its own system/path, queue both bookings
When collecting payment, use Zendesk separate GDS and LCC amount fields — add separately, never combine
Use Rebooking Wizard for GDS/Farelogix PNR to Ticketing; use Sync Trip for LCC/portal PNR (do NOT use Sync Trip for GDS)
forbidden: Do not assume rebooking one PNR in multi-PNR order automatically applies to the other
Do not combine GDS and LCC charge amounts into single Zendesk field
Do not use Sync Trip for GDS/Farelogix PNR — goes through Rebooking Wizard
handoff: Fulfillment/Ticketing (Rebooking Wizard) for GDS; LCC routine for LCC
source: 03. Multi-PNR routine: Notes, Payments, Queuing; Section 4: Sync Trip

title: Multi-PNR: Documentation, Fees & Queuing Rules
when: Order has multiple PNRs (LCC+GDS or several GDS PNRs)
Documenting, charging, or queuing a rebooking/reroute
fl_steps: Internal notes: always prefix with which PNR note belongs to, e.g. [PNR_1]: rebook to new date; [PNR_2]: no change
Order note and Text to customer for payment: state which PNR payment belongs to, to which pax, and what it is for
Add retention line in all PNRs, not just the one being changed
If both PNRs need rebooking, queue both, but write service fee only in first PNR Summary; on second PNR write 'Multi PNR' under Other remarks
LCC + GDS combo: write service fee in GDS booking, not LCC one
forbidden: Do not write service fee in both PNRs
Do not omit PNR reference in internal notes or customer text
source: 03. Multi-PNR routine: Notes, Payments, Queuing

title: Multi-PNR: LCC+GDS Void Automation Exception
when: Order has multiple PNRs, at least one LCC and at least one GDS
Customer confirms cancelling/voiding only the GDS PNR (same-day void)
fl_steps: Void Automation does NOT apply to this case even if GDS ticket is within void window — proceed manually
Manually void GDS ticket and process cancellation following normal manual Void steps
Do not run Modify Order to Void automation for this mixed scenario
forbidden: Do not run automated Void on multi-PNR LCC+GDS order where only GDS PNR is confirmed for cancellation
source: Section 1: Void Automation: Step-by-Step (Exception: Multi PNR Orders)

title: Payment Method: MOTO (Secure IVR) vs Payment Link (PL)
when: Any phone interaction where customer needs to be charged post-booking
Deciding between MOTO (Secure IVR) Payment and a Payment Link (PL)
fl_steps: Default preference is MOTO Payment — completes charge inside call so request can be finalized without delay

MOTO limitations check: phone only (never chat); not available for LATAM markets (hidden in Edvin); Maestro not accepted on CA/AU; not possible when under supervisor monitoring or via embedded Genesys in Zendesk (use Genesys app directly)
Exception: for SC second alternative requiring YY phone authorization, always send Payment Link — never use MOTO
If MOTO unavailable, limitation applies, or customer declines, send Payment Link instead
PL validity: Rebooking = 30 min (exceptionally up to 1h); Ancillary = 48h; Name change = 48h; Other = 24h — shorten if departure sooner
ATH/UPA ticketing offices: same-day PL can never exceed 16:30 local office time
Never combine multiple orders into single PL — send one PL per order
If customer cannot pay during interaction: inform request handled within 24h of payment, price/seats not guaranteed, CCE will follow up if price changes
forbidden: Do not offer MOTO for chat, LATAM markets, Maestro on AU/CA, monitored calls, or Genesys inside Zendesk
Do not use MOTO for SC second alternative requiring YY phone authorization
Do not combine multiple orders into single Payment Link
handoff: Customer Care Escalations (if PL paid after interaction ends)
source: 1. Secure IVR Payment (MOTO Payment); 2. Payment link (PL)

title: ETG Service Fee: Standard Rates & Exemptions
when: Any request subject to ETG service fee
Before quoting total price to customer
fl_steps: Standard fees (VAT incl): 15 EUR/pax for finding alternative beyond airline offer on SC; 40 EUR/pax for voluntary changes/cancellations or manual assistance (new booking/add pax); 65 EUR/pax only for post-departure refund inquiries due to non-attendance (no-show)
NO SERVICE FEE: SC/FM/GDPR-Waiver cancellations; SC rebooking 1st alternative; FM rebooking (open ticket/voucher)
NO SERVICE FEE for INF passengers unless adding infant to booking
NO SERVICE FEE AT ALL on Booking.com orders, Business class orders, or Platinum service orders
1A Travel Seller orders: flat 15 EUR/pax applies for voluntary and involuntary
Communicate fee in customer market currency per official price list
Market exceptions: FR (tax-only CXL = 20% of refund; My Portal = no fee), BR (void/24h = no fee), AT (SC 2nd alt = no fee), KR (check KR consolidator table), UA (all fees waived)
Kayak metasearch 24h US rule: no fee if paid <24h, US route, full refund allowed, departure >=8 days
forbidden: Do not charge service fee on SC/FM/GDPR cancellations or SC 1st alt rebooking
Do not charge any service fee on Booking.com, Business class, or Platinum Package orders
Do not skip per-PNR eligibility check for Kayak 24h US policy on multi-PNR orders
source: 1. Applicable ETG service fees

title: ETG Service Fee: Multi-PNR Calculation Rule
when: Deciding how much service fee to charge across those PNRs
fl_steps: Charge service fee once per person/order — NEVER once per PNR
If different PNRs in same order attract different fee amounts/exceptions, charge HIGHEST of applicable fees
If customer only changes/cancels PNR qualifying for no-fee exception, no fee applies; if whole order or fee-bearing PNR changed, charge normally
forbidden: Do not charge service fee more than once for same person's request across multiple PNRs
source: 1. Applicable ETG service fees (Multi-PNR Orders and Service Fee)

title: GDS NACO: Eligibility Gate & Order Checks
fl_steps: Hold briefly and open Edvin Documents for validating carrier NAME / NACO policy — never rely on memory or what customer says YY told them
Clarify exact passenger + correct name as on passport/ID; on phone ask customer to spell letter-by-letter
Run order gates first: chargeback -> stop; active SC -> handle SC first; FM/Travel Alert -> handle FM first; coupon must be O or A else use coupon-status branch
Time-to-departure gate: if departure within 24h (own-office/ID ticket) or 72h (consolidator ticket), refer customer to airline unless Edvin explicitly requires us to attempt
Check Void window next (GDS/Portals): if still void-eligible, prefer Void + new ticket sell with correct name when policy/system allows — cleaner than blocked NACO on codeshare
Classify: NACO = same person minor fix (typo/middle name/marriage spelling); NACH = transfer to different person entirely — airline definition may differ, Edvin wins
Booking.com / Business class / Platinum: no ETG service fee on request itself — still check airline penalty separately
BR market (Gotogate/Mytrip/Flightnetwork/Booking.com BR): always escalate to Support to contact airline for written authorization per ANAC art.8 before any correction
alternatives: Void and rebook if within window
forbidden: Do not promise NACO is possible before Edvin policy is checked
Do not let customer dictate process based only on what YY said on their side call
Do not charge any name-change fee before path is confirmed
source: 2. Name correction/change - General process; 1. General information about NACO/NACH; 3. Name correction/change within the Void period

title: GDS NACO: Codeshare Block / Not Permitted by Policy
when: Edvin Documents state name correction/change is not permitted
OR multi-airline / codeshare ticket where Edvin/Shelf indicates NACO/NACH is not possible
fl_steps: State boundary calmly and specifically: per airline policy recorded in documents for validating carrier, name correction is not permitted (codeshare technical limitation is common)
Do NOT call airline yourself from FL to 'double-check if they can travel with typo' — helpdesk will not guarantee travel with name error
Do NOT invent a live transfer to 'senior manager' — path does not exist as warm handoff; if customer asks for supervisor, use Supervisor callback path

Offer lawful alternatives only: (1) if inside Void — Void + new ticket with correct name ($0 ETG fee on Booking.com); (2) voluntary cancellation per fare rules; (3) keep ticket as-is with honesty that we cannot authorize travel with mismatched name
Register Zendesk/errand action 'Not permitted' (Silent child ticket) when outcome is policy block with information only
If customer claims airline promised exception or said 'Booking.com only needs to contact YY', switch immediately to gds_naco_customer_claims_yy_exception
alternatives: Void + new ticket sell if void still open
Supervisor callback queue if customer demands supervisor
forbidden: Do not contact YY yourself as FL when Docs already say not permitted and contact is not authorized
Do not promise that Booking.com will force airline to change codeshare name
Do not warm-transfer to senior management / TL as a live call — not allowed
Do not guarantee passenger can fly with spelling error
handoff: None for pure Not permitted; Support only if customer claims YY exception; Supervisor callback queue if requested
source: 2. Name correction/change - General process (Airline Policy Check — codeshare note + not permitted)

title: GDS NACO: Customer Claims Airline Promised Exception
when: Customer says airline already promised a fix / exception
OR customer says YY told them agency/Booking.com only needs to contact airline
fl_steps: Acknowledge mismatch without attacking airline: hear that airline gave different message; our side must verify in writing through authorized channel
Explain FL boundary in one sentence: First Line cannot cold-call airline on this; Support is the team that contacts airline for verification and instructions
Escalate to Support per Escalations to Support guidelines — adjust handling deadline manually if departure is tight
Never charge ETG service fee, airline NACO fee, or name-change cost until Support confirms it is possible
For Booking.com orders still state no ETG service fee if/when chargeable path confirmed
Set expectation: Support will verify with airline and update customer via registered email; not refusing help — using only auditable channel
Errand action: 'Sent to Support' (Active child ticket)
alternatives: Supervisor callback queue if customer rejects Support path and insists on manager
forbidden: Do not charge any fee before Support confirms possibility
Do not tell customer you will personally call YY if FL is not authorized
Do not dismiss customer's YY conversation as a lie — verify via Support
source: 2. Name correction/change - General process -> Other Scenarios and Handling -> Exception by Airline

title: GDS NACO: Supervisor Callback Queue (De-escalation)
when: Customer demands supervisor / manager / senior management on NACO/NACH or any phone interaction
Warm transfer to senior management is not allowed
fl_steps: Stay steady: do not argue hierarchy; do not pretend live senior manager join is available if policy forbids it
Explain real path: escalate to Supervisor callback queue so supervisor contacts them — authorized escalation, not live barge-in
Capture callback number, registered email, order ID, and 2-line case summary (policy block / codeshare / customer claims YY exception / fees discussed)
Complete escalation per site process into Supervisor call-back queue
Errand action: 'Customer requested Supervisor - Escalated' (Active child ticket)
If underlying issue is still 'YY promised exception', also keep/send Support path in parallel — supervisor callback for de-escalation, Support for airline verification
forbidden: Do not invent a live transfer to TL/senior management when not permitted
Do not hang up without offering authorized supervisor callback path when customer demands supervisor
source: 2. Name correction/change - General process (Errand Paths — Customer requested Supervisor)

title: GDS NACO: Permitted Standard Reissue Flow
when: Edvin policy permits change (or case-to-case authorized by Support)
fl_steps: Confirm docs/authorization needs from Edvin; if docs/YY authorization required -> collect passport via Etrack/ZD public reply and/or escalate Support before charging airline fee
Quote airline penalty (if any) + ETG service fee if applicable (skip ETG fee on Booking.com / Business / Platinum)
Phone: email verification gate before charge/process on issued-ticket voluntary NACO; prefer MOTO, else PL <=48h
Name confirmation on phone if no docs: Blank template or PL text with Surname: X / First Name: Y; customer confirms during call
Effective 02 Mar 2026: GDS/Farelogix NACO/NACH and related EMD fee issuance go via Rebooking Wizard -> Rebooking Queue (Type of change Manual / New Ticket / EMD)
Warn EMD ancillaries may disconnect and need repurchase; ETG products tied to old PNR may not carry over if new PNR created
Zendesk handoff Fulfillment + Resolved when sent to ticketing
alternatives: Void path if still in void and cleaner
forbidden: Do not finalize GDS NACO outside Rebooking Wizard when Mar 2026 rule applies
Do not skip email verification on phone for issued-ticket voluntary NACO
handoff: Fulfillment/Ticketing via Rebooking Wizard (GDS/Farelogix); Support when auth/docs required
source: 2. Name correction/change - General process; Edvin Rebooking Wizard Name Change/Correction
